skillsbench-host-grading.name: skillsbench-host-grading
key_points: ALWAYS bake deliverables into the container image via `COPY` in `environment/Dockerfile` — host grading rebuilds from scratch
NEVER rely on runtime script execution for grading — the output file must exist as a baked layer in the image
DO NOT run pytest only inside a container session — host grading rebuilds and runs tests independently
skillsbench-host-grading.description: Host-side grading protocol for SkillsBench tasks: Docker-baked deliverables verified by mounted pytest tests.
